mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `membership` ( user_id, tenant_id, role, status, joined_at, invited_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{tenantId}, #{role}, #{status}, #{joinedAt}, #{invitedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE `membership` SET role = #{role}, status = #{status}, joined_at = #{joinedAt}, invited_at = #{invitedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, tenant_id, role, status, joined_at, invited_at, created_at, updated_at FROM `membership` WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY id DESC
